content: यत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (यतते, यतित) .²1 To attempt, endeavour, strive, try (usually with <ab>inf.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>); सर्वः कल्ये वयसि यतते लब्धुमर्थान् कुटुम्बी <ls>V. 3. 1</ls>. .²2 To strive after, be eager or anxious for, long for; या न ययौ प्रियमन्यवधूभ्यः सारतरागमना यतमानम् <ls>Śi. 4. 45</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 7</ls>. .²3 To exert oneself, persevere, labour. .²4 To observe caution, be watchful; यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः <ls>Bg. 2. 60</ls>. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> To excite, stir up, rouse. .²6 To join, associate with. .²7 To go, proceed. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (यातयति-ते) To return, repay, requite, recompense, restore. .²2 To despise, censure. .²3 To encourage, animate. .²4 To torture, distress, annoy. .²5 To prepare, elaborate. .²6 <ab>Ved.</ab> To join, unite. .²7 To cause to be returned or restored.
यत् {%a.%} Going, moving; स्थितं च यच्च (ब्रह्मणो रूपे) <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 3. 1</ls>.
